stem:
The box plots summarize the number of semester hours students enrolled in a university and a community college completed during the fall semester.

Which statement is best supported by the data in the box plots?

options.label: A
options.text: The median of the data for the university is greater than the median of the data for the community college.

options.label: B
options.text: The range of the data for the university is greater than the range of the data for the community college.

options.label: C
options.text: The interquartile range of the data for the community college is greater than the interquartile range of the data for the university.

options.label: D
options.text: The third quartile of the data for the community college is greater than the third quartile of the data for the university.

visual_elements: Box plot comparing university and community college semester hours with a scale from 2 to 18.
